changelog: Virtual TV 1.0.0 is the first official public full release for Jellyfin 12.1. It promotes the validated 2.0.1.4 test build without changing playback or scheduling behavior, and includes Standard TV and Personalized TV, weighted True Random, watched-aware modes, Content Coverage, compact channel actions, and per-channel configuration import/export.
description: Virtual linear TV channels generated from media already available in Jellyfin.
name: Virtual TV
overview: Virtual linear TV channels inside Jellyfin.
